vaccines.label: Enhanced
vaccines.zh: 加強型流感疫苗（佐劑或高劑量，未指明）

policy.title_zh: 公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 請符合資格民眾儘速接種 及早獲得保護力
policy.title_en: Public flu and COVID-19 vaccine uptake strong; eligible people urged to get vaccinated early
policy.summary: Taiwan CDC reports higher flu and COVID-19 vaccination numbers than last year under the 2026-27 public programme, urges high-risk groups to vaccinate before the holiday travel period, and gives current flu and COVID-19 activity figures.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示115年度公費流感及COVID-19疫苗接種人次高於去年同期，呼籲高風險族群連假前儘速接種，並公布目前流感與COVID-19疫情數據。
policy.why: Taiwan CDC's statement that uptake is ahead of last year frames the programme as a success and adds urgency before holiday travel.
policy.why_zh: 疾管署表示接種率超越去年同期，將計畫定調為成功，並在連假出遊前增添緊迫感。

policy.title_zh: 「左流右新 護肺顧心」10月1日公費流感及新冠疫苗同步開打
policy.title_en: "Protect Lungs, Safeguard Heart": public flu and COVID-19 vaccines launch together on October 1
policy.summary: The Taiwan CDC launched the 2026 public flu and COVID-19 vaccination programme on October 1, urging eligible people to get both vaccines, with enhanced flu vaccines prioritised for long-term care residents aged 65 and over and both Moderna and Novavax COVID-19 vaccines supplied.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署於10月1日啟動115年度公費流感及COVID-19疫苗接種，呼籲符合資格民眾同時接種，加強型流感疫苗優先提供長照及安養機構65歲以上長者，並供應Moderna與Novavax兩種COVID-19疫苗。
policy.why: The official joint launch confirmed that enhanced flu vaccines go first to long-term care residents aged 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax COVID-19 vaccines are supplied.
policy.why_zh: 官方聯合開打確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，並同時供應Moderna與Novavax COVID-19疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 2026年度公費流感及新冠疫苗第一階段將於10月1日開打 接種左流右新疫苗還可獲得1350健康幣
policy.title_en: Publicly funded flu and COVID-19 vaccines phase one opens October 1; joint campaign offers 1,350 health coins
policy.summary: The CDC announces that phase one of publicly funded flu and COVID-19 vaccination opens October 1 for 11 groups, with supply, eligibility, self-pay options, flu and COVID-19 disease data, and Moderna's new-generation COVID-19 vaccine described, and urges eligible people to get vaccinated.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署宣布公費流感與COVID-19疫苗第一階段10月1日開打，說明11類對象、疫苗供應、自費管道、疫情數據及Moderna新世代COVID-19疫苗資料，並呼籲符合資格民眾踴躍接種。
policy.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠於仍處流行期且流感疫情持續上升 呼籲民眾連假期間加強自主防疫 出現重症危險徵兆儘速就醫
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID-19 still high; CDC urges self-protection during holiday and early care for severe signs
policy.summary: The Taiwan CDC reports flu and COVID-19 remain prevalent, notes most severe cases were unvaccinated, and urges self-protection and prompt care for danger signs ahead of the Mid-Autumn holiday.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感與COVID-19仍在流行，重症病例多未接種疫苗，呼籲中秋連假期間加強自主防疫並儘速就醫。

policy.title_zh: 疾病管制署延長擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用對象「有類流感症狀，且具下列身分之流感高傳播族群」之適用期限至115年10月31日止，籲請醫師善用公費藥劑，共同防治流感。(疾病管制署致醫界通函第616號)
policy.title_en: CDC extends public flu antiviral eligibility for high-transmission groups until 31 October 2026
policy.summary: The CDC extends the public flu antiviral eligibility for high-transmission groups until 31 October as flu activity keeps rising and asks doctors to use the public antiviral stock.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署延長公費流感抗病毒藥劑對流感高傳播族群的適用期限至10月31日，因流感疫情持續上升，並籲請醫師善用公費藥劑。

policy.title_zh: 目前流感疫情持續上升 公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥條件將延長至今(115)年10月31日止
policy.title_en: Flu activity keeps rising; public flu antiviral eligibility extended to 31 October 2026
policy.summary: The CDC says flu activity keeps rising and extends the public flu antiviral eligibility until 31 October, urging the public to take precautions and seek care promptly; the release also mentions the vaccine map for COVID-19 and flu.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感疫情持續上升，延長公費流感抗病毒藥劑適用期限至10月31日，並呼籲民眾做好防護、儘速就醫；新聞稿亦提及COVID-19與流感疫苗地圖。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠疫情均處流行期且流感疫情持續上升 呼籲民眾落實勤洗手 戴口罩等自我防護措施 並留意重症危險徵兆
policy.title_en: Influenza and COVID-19 both in epidemic period with flu rising; CDC urges hand hygiene, masks and watching for severe warning signs
policy.summary: Taiwan CDC reports rising flu activity and COVID-19 still in its epidemic period, notes most severe cases were unvaccinated, and urges prevention measures and prompt medical care for high-risk groups.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感疫情持續上升、COVID-19仍處流行期，重症病例多未接種疫苗，呼籲民眾落實防護措施並及早就醫。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠仍有傳播風險 呼籲民眾出現症狀戴口罩就醫並在家休息 且留意重症危險徵兆
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID-19 still pose transmission risk; people with symptoms urged to wear masks, seek care and rest at home, and watch for warning signs
policy.summary: The CDC says flu has entered its epidemic period and COVID-19 still circulates, reporting most severe flu cases were unvaccinated this season and advising masks, medical care and attention to warning signs.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感已進入流行期、COVID-19仍有傳播風險，並指本季流感重症多數未接種疫苗，建議出現症狀時戴口罩就醫、留意危險徵兆。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠疫情持續 呼籲民眾留意個人衛生習慣 出現重症危險徵兆應儘速就醫治療
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID-19 outbreaks continue; CDC urges hygiene and urgent treatment for severe warning signs
policy.summary: The CDC reports rising flu visits and severe cases, notes most severe patients were unvaccinated, and urges older adults and at-risk people to get COVID-19 vaccines soon as about 110,000 doses remain available until September 9.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署指出流感門急診及重症增加、多數重症個案未接種疫苗，並呼籲長者與重症高風險者儘速接種COVID-19疫苗，目前約剩11萬劑，供應至9月9日。

policy.title_zh: 因應各級學校即將開學，疾管署呼籲學校與家長落實衛生防護，防範腸病毒、新冠、流感及登革熱疫情
policy.title_en: CDC urges schools and parents to take hygiene measures against enterovirus, COVID-19, flu and dengue ahead of term
policy.summary: The CDC urges schools and parents to practise hygiene ahead of term, reports COVID-19 and flu trends including low vaccine uptake among severe cases, and reminds eligible people to get COVID-19 vaccines before supplies end.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署呼籲開學前落實校園衛生防護，通報COVID-19與流感趨勢，並提醒符合資格民眾儘速接種COVID-19疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 115年秋冬公費首度導入加強型流感及新世代新冠疫苗 疫苗株全更新精準防護 疾管署呼籲流感新冠同時打「左流右新 護肺顧心」
policy.title_en: Enhanced flu and new-generation COVID-19 vaccines public for first time in 2026-27 autumn-winter; CDC urges both flu and COVID shots
policy.summary: The CDC announces the 2026-27 public flu and COVID-19 vaccine procurement, including adjuvanted and high-dose enhanced flu vaccines, Moderna and Novavax COVID-19 vaccines, and urges people to get both, with self-pay also referenced.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署公布115年秋冬公費流感及COVID-19疫苗採購，包括佐劑及高劑量加強型流感疫苗，以及Moderna與NovavaxCOVID-19疫苗，並呼籲民眾兩種都要接種，另提及自費接種。

policy.title_zh: 疾管署自今年8月24日至9月30日擴大公費藥劑使用對象(疾病管制署致醫界通函第613號)
policy.title_en: CDC letter to medical community: expanding public flu antiviral drug use from August 24 to September 30
policy.summary: CDC letter to doctors expands public flu antiviral eligibility to high-transmission groups from August 24 to September 30 as flu visits edge up.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署致醫界函說明，因流感就診微幅上升，自8月24日至9月30日擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑適用對象至高傳播族群。

policy.title_zh: 國內新冠疫情仍處流行期 提醒各級學校於開學前妥為整備 加強自主防疫觀念宣導
policy.title_en: COVID-19 still epidemic ahead of school opening; schools urged to strengthen self-prevention
policy.summary: CDC urges schools to prepare before September reopening and encourages high-risk people to get the remaining COVID-19 vaccine stock before September 9.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署提醒開學前學校加強防疫，並鼓勵高風險民眾把握9月9日前接種剩餘的COVID-19疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 國內外近期流感疫情緩升，疾管署自今年8月24日起至9月30日擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用條件
policy.title_en: Flu activity edges up in Taiwan and abroad; CDC expands public flu antiviral eligibility from August 24
policy.summary: CDC announces expanded public flu antiviral eligibility from August 24 to September 30 as flu visits rise, and notes that 72 percent of severe cases were unvaccinated against seasonal flu.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署宣布自8月24日至9月30日擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑適用條件，並指出重症病例多數未接種本季流感疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 國內流感疫情雖尚未進入流行期，但已有緩升趨勢，以A型流感為主
policy.title_en: Domestic influenza activity has not yet reached epidemic season but is trending upward, mainly type A
policy.summary: The CDC reports influenza activity rising since early July, mainly A-type with H1N1 predominant, and notes 73% of severe cases this season were unvaccinated against influenza; it lists public antiviral stocks and a combined flu and COVID-19 vaccine map.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示國內流感疫情自7月起緩升，以A型為主（H1N1居多），本季重症病例73%未接種流感疫苗；並提供公費藥劑資訊及流感COVID-19疫苗查詢地圖。

policy.title_zh: 國內新冠疫情持續升溫，本季新冠疫苗將於8月13日全數撥配至各縣市提供民眾接種 有需求民眾請儘速接種
policy.title_en: Domestic COVID-19 cases keep rising; this season's COVID-19 vaccines will be fully allocated to counties on 13 August; people in need should get vaccinated soon
policy.summary: The CDC urges people who need COVID-19 vaccination to get it soon, as about 37,000 central stock doses will be allocated on 13 August and the season's vaccines are available until 9 September; 89.6% of recent severe cases were unvaccinated.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署呼籲有需求民眾儘速接種COVID-19疫苗，8月13日將撥配約3.7萬劑中央庫存，本季疫苗接種至9月9日止；近期重症病例89.6%未接種。

policy.title_zh: 國內新冠疫情上升且處流行期 呼籲尚未接種疫苗的民眾儘快接種 並落實勤洗手、戴口罩等自我防護措施
policy.title_en: CDC urges people not yet vaccinated to get COVID-19 shots as domestic cases rise and enter epidemic period
policy.summary: The CDC urges unvaccinated people to get COVID-19 vaccines now, reports rising cases and ICU admissions, and says about 165,000 doses remain with the extended vaccination period running to September 28.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署呼籲尚未接種的民眾儘快接種COVID-19疫苗，並通報疫情上升、重症增加，目前庫存約16.5萬劑，擴大接種期間延長至9月28日。

policy.title_zh: 國內公費 COVID-19口服抗病毒藥物Molnupiravir均已屆效，籲請醫師依「新型冠狀病毒（SARS-CoV-2）感染臨床處置指引」評估使用其他替代藥物(疾病管制署致醫界通函第611號)
policy.title_en: Publicly funded COVID-19 oral antiviral Molnupiravir all expired; doctors urged to consider alternative drugs (CDC letter No. 611)
policy.summary: The CDC notifies doctors that publicly funded Molnupiravir stock has expired and urges them to consider alternative COVID-19 antivirals such as Paxlovid, citing limited efficacy and safety concerns.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署通知醫界，公費COVID-19口服抗病毒藥物Molnupiravir庫存已屆效，建議評估使用Paxlovid等替代藥物，並提及其療效有限與安全性疑慮。

policy.title_zh: 新冠疫情持續升溫 尚未接種本季新冠疫苗民眾請儘速接種獲得保護力 如有疑似症狀請儘速就醫
policy.title_en: COVID-19 keeps rising; people who have not had this season's COVID-19 vaccine should get it quickly; CDC urges prompt vaccination
policy.summary: The CDC urges people who have not had this season's COVID-19 vaccine to get it quickly, notes public vaccine programme extended to 28 September, and reports stock of about 437,000 doses of Moderna and Novavax.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署籲尚未接種本季COVID-19疫苗者儘速接種，公費接種延長至9月28日，並公布Moderna與Novavax庫存約43.7萬劑。

policy.title_zh: 新冠疫苗充足 已協助增加配送量提供臺北市政府衛生局撥配轄區合約醫療院所提供民眾接種
policy.title_en: COVID-19 vaccine supply sufficient; distribution increased to help Taipei City Health Bureau allocate doses to contracted clinics
policy.summary: Taiwan CDC says COVID-19 vaccine supply is sufficient, it increased distribution to Taipei, sending 6,000 doses to contracted clinics, and urges unvaccinated people to get vaccinated.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示COVID-19疫苗供應充足，已協助增加配送量支援台北市，將由合約醫療院所提供6,000劑，並呼籲尚未接種者儘速接種。

policy.title_zh: 新冠疫苗擴大全民接種延長至9月28日 尚有約44萬劑提供全民免費接種
policy.title_en: Free COVID-19 vaccination expanded and extended to September 28; about 440,000 doses available
policy.summary: The CDC extends publicly funded COVID-19 vaccination to September 28 for people aged six months and older who have not been vaccinated this season, reports about 440,000 doses in stock including Moderna and Novavax, urges high-risk groups to get a second dose, and lists antiviral and rapid test supplies.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署宣布公費COVID-19疫苗擴大提供滿6個月以上尚未接種民眾，接種期延長至9月28日，庫存約44萬劑，包含Moderna與Novavax，並呼籲高風險對象可接種第2劑，同時說明抗病毒藥物與快篩庫存。

policy.title_zh: Novavax疫苗僅餘4,000劑提供接種至7月底 請民眾把握機會儘速接種
policy.title_en: Only 4,000 Novavax doses left, valid through end of July; urges people to get vaccinated promptly
policy.summary: The CDC says only 4,000 Novavax doses remain for public vaccination until end of July, urges eligible people to get Novavax promptly, and says Moderna supply is about 443,000 doses. It also urges high-risk groups to get a second dose.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示公費Novavax疫苗僅剩4,000劑且7月底到期，Moderna約44.3萬劑；並呼籲高風險族群儘快接種第2劑。

policy.title_zh: 國內新冠疫情持續呈上升趨勢 呼籲尚未接種疫苗民眾儘速接種 落實個人防護措施 具重症風險因子民眾出現疑似症狀可由醫師評估後給藥
policy.title_en: Domestic COVID-19 keeps rising; CDC urges unvaccinated people to get vaccinated promptly and take personal protection
policy.summary: The CDC urges unvaccinated people to get the publicly funded Moderna or Novavax COVID-19 vaccine promptly, noting both are safe and effective, as cases keep rising and enter a prevalence phase.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署呼籲尚未接種的民眾儘速接種公費Moderna或Novavax的COVID-19疫苗，並說明兩種廠牌均安全有效，因國內病例持續上升、已進入流行期。

policy.title_zh: 國內近期新冠疫情上升，籲請醫師鼓勵尚未接種疫苗者踴躍施打新冠疫苗，就診病患如符合抗病毒藥物使用條件建議進行快篩後評估給藥(疾病管制署致醫界通函第610號)
policy.title_en: Rising domestic COVID-19 activity; CDC urges doctors to encourage unvaccinated patients to get COVID-19 vaccines and to assess antiviral eligibility with rapid tests
policy.summary: The Taiwan CDC letter to physicians urges them to encourage vaccination through the extended public programme to July 31, reports ample Moderna and Novavax stock, and advises rapid testing before antiviral prescribing.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署致醫界通函指出國內COVID-19疫情上升，請醫師鼓勵未接種者施打公費疫苗至7月31日，並說明Moderna與Novavax庫存充足，建議快篩後評估抗病毒藥物。

policy.title_zh: 新冠疫情持續升溫 籲請民眾接種疫苗 具重症風險因子者出現疑似症狀儘速就醫
policy.title_en: COVID-19 rising; public urged to get vaccinated, and people with severe-risk factors urged to seek care promptly if symptoms appear
policy.summary: The Taiwan CDC urges people to get this season's COVID-19 vaccine, reports that over 65s are mostly unvaccinated among severe cases, cites vaccine effectiveness data, and notes public-funded extended eligibility to July 31 with Moderna and Novavax stock.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署呼籲民眾接種本季COVID-19疫苗，指出重症病例多為未接種之65歲以上長者，引述保護效果數據，並說明公費接種擴大至7月31日且Moderna與Novavax庫存充足。

entries.headline: Weekly flu deaths and severe cases hit five-year high as vaccination rush builds
entries.why: Multiple outlets report 44 flu deaths and 219 severe cases in one week, a five-year high, with older adults making up most severe cases. This lifts demand on the public programme (公費) and puts protection of priority groups under scrutiny.
entries.headline_zh: 每週流感死亡及重症病例創五年新高，疫苗接種潮升溫
entries.why_zh: 多家媒體報導單週流感死亡44例、重症219例，創五年新高，重症多為長者。此情勢推升公費疫苗需求，優先族群的保護措施也受到檢視。

entries.headline: Taiwan CDC says public flu and COVID-19 uptake is running above last year
entries.zh: 公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 請符合資格民眾儘速接種 及早獲得保護力
entries.why: In the public programme (公費), outlets citing CDC data report 1.32 million flu doses in six days and that half of seniors are more willing to take both vaccines together. Over 550,000 people have redeemed health coins, so the pace raises questions about allocation and replenishment.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署表示公費流感及COVID-19疫苗接種量高於去年同期
entries.why_zh: 在公費計畫方面，媒體引用疾管署資料報導，6天內接種流感疫苗132萬劑，且半數長者更願意同時接種兩種疫苗。逾55萬人已兌換健康幣，接種速度引發疫苗分配與補貨的疑問。

entries.headline: Cluster of 16 infant infections at Changhua postpartum care centre puts RSV in focus
entries.why: A single outlet reports 16 infants infected within 20 days, and the report does not say whether care would be publicly funded or self-paid. RSV mentions rose to 31 from 8 week on week, and parent posts discuss antibodies at birth, so infant protection may climb the stakeholder agenda.
entries.headline_zh: 彰化產後護理之家16名嬰兒群聚感染，RSV受關注
entries.why_zh: 單一媒體報導20天內16名嬰兒受感染，報導未說明照護費用屬公費或自費。RSV聲量較前週由8則升至31則，家長貼文討論出生即施打抗體，嬰兒保護議題可能在利害關係人議程中升溫。

entries.headline: Fact-checkers rebut rumour that the public enhanced flu vaccine is mRNA
entries.why: This concerns the public programme's first enhanced (adjuvanted and high-dose) vaccines. Opinion columns frame them as a strategy for a super-aged society, while enhanced-vaccine mentions fell to 35 from 90 after the launch.
entries.headline_zh: 事實查核機構駁斥公費加強型流感疫苗為mRNA之謠言
entries.why_zh: 此事涉及公費計畫首度採用的加強型（含佐劑及高劑量）疫苗。評論專欄將其定位為超高齡社會的因應策略，而加強型疫苗聲量在上市後由90則降至35則。

entries.headline: COVID-19 safety claims circulate on Threads, from brain damage to suppressed side effects
entries.why: These are unverified posts that name no brand and do not state funding. The widest-reach post (4,000+ engagements) alleges media silence on side effects, and a newspaper fact-check desk separately labelled a '74% of autopsies' claim false.
entries.headline_zh: COVID-19疫苗安全性說法在Threads流傳，從腦損傷到副作用遭掩蓋
entries.why_zh: 這些為未經查證的貼文，未提及品牌，也未說明公費或自費。觸及最廣的貼文（互動逾4,000次）指稱媒體對副作用噤聲；另有報社事實查核單位判定「74%解剖案例」說法為錯誤。

entries.headline: Experts urge mRNA plants in Taiwan; Moderna executive praises health policy
entries.why: This is a supply-resilience and industrial-policy debate rather than a question about this season's programme, though one version mentions self-pay costs. Separately, Medigen says it filed a report over an anonymous online post alleging a COVID-19 procurement price.
entries.headline_zh: 專家呼籲在台設立mRNA疫苗廠；Moderna高層稱讚衛生政策
entries.why_zh: 此為供應韌性與產業政策的討論，而非針對本季接種計畫的議題，但其中一則報導提及自費費用。另外，高端表示已就一則指稱COVID-19疫苗採購價格的匿名網路貼文提出檢舉。

watch.text: Whether flu severe cases and deaths stay at five-year highs, which would keep pressure on uptake among older adults.
watch.when_zh: 疾管署下週監測資料發布
watch.text_zh: 流感重症及死亡是否持續處於五年高點，若是將持續帶給長者接種壓力。

watch.text: Follow-up on the Changhua postpartum care centre infant cluster and any health-authority response on infant RSV protection.
watch.text_zh: 追蹤彰化產後護理之家嬰兒群聚事件後續，以及衛生主管機關對嬰兒RSV保護的回應。

qa.q: Is public flu supply holding up under the rush?
qa.a: No official shortage notice has appeared in the last 14 days, and CDC reports uptake above last year. Taoyuan added 11,000 doses for school staff, while one post reports a clinic that had run out of flu vaccine; that claim is unverified.
qa.q_zh: 公費流感疫苗供應能否撐過接種潮？
qa.a_zh: 過去14天未見官方缺貨公告，疾管署表示接種量高於去年。桃園為學校教職員追加11,000劑；另有一則貼文指某診所流感疫苗已用完，此說法未經證實。

qa.q: Is the enhanced flu vaccine attracting scrutiny?
qa.a: Yes, but limited. Fact-checkers rebutted a rumour that it is mRNA, and opinion columns discuss it as aging-society policy. Overall enhanced-vaccine mentions dropped to 35 from 90 after launch coverage faded.
qa.q_zh: 加強型流感疫苗是否受到檢視？
qa.a_zh: 是，但有限。事實查核機構駁斥其為mRNA的謠言，評論專欄則將其視為高齡社會政策討論。隨上市報導退燒，加強型疫苗整體聲量由90則降至35則。

qa.q: Does the infant cluster create an RSV issue?
qa.a: Potentially. One outlet reports 16 infant infections in 20 days at a postpartum care centre, RSV mentions rose to 31 from 8, and parent posts discuss antibodies at birth. No official RSV statement appears in the last 14 days.
qa.q_zh: 嬰兒群聚事件是否形成RSV議題？
qa.a_zh: 有可能。一家媒體報導某產後護理之家20天內16名嬰兒受感染，RSV聲量由8則升至31則，家長貼文討論出生即施打抗體。過去14天未見官方RSV聲明。

voices.text: A person reports that two Kaohsiung clinics said self-paid flu vaccine will not be available until November.
voices.text_zh: 有人反映，高雄兩家診所表示自費流感疫苗要到11月才會供應。

voices.text: A post repeating a conspiracy claim that COVID-19 vaccines caused virus resurgence in several places, citing a livestream by a known conspiracy promoter.
voices.text_zh: 一則貼文重複陰謀論說法，主張多地COVID-19疫苗接種導致病毒復發，並引用某陰謀論人士直播內容作為依據。

voices.text: A user reports a family member briefly lost consciousness with convulsions, recovered after about two minutes, and had a similar episode after a previous COVID-19 vaccination, asking whether others have experienced this.
voices.text_zh: 貼文者描述家人短暫失去意識並抽搐，約兩分鐘後恢復，且曾在接種COVID-19疫苗後發生類似情況，詢問他人是否有相同經驗。

voices.text: A clinic promotes an adjuvanted flu vaccine, claiming 20 to 30 percent better protection and 12 months of coverage, and invites people to get it at its clinic.
voices.text_zh: 一家診所宣傳含佐劑流感疫苗，聲稱保護力提升20至30%、可維持12個月，並邀請民眾至診所接種。

voices.text: A parent shares that two children received the nasal flu vaccine this year, and one developed a fever about 36 hours later that lasted roughly two days before resolving.
voices.text_zh: 家長分享兩個孩子今年接種鼻噴流感疫苗，其中一名孩子約36小時後發燒，經過約兩天後退燒恢復正常。

voices.text: A forum repost of a news article reports that publicly funded flu and COVID-19 vaccines start October 1 for 11 priority groups, with health coins for vaccination, enhanced flu vaccine supply, and Moderna COVID-19 vaccines.
voices.text_zh: 一則論壇轉貼的新聞報導指出，公費流感與COVID-19疫苗將於十月一日起開放，適用十一類優先對象，並提到接種可使用健保補助的健康存摺、流感疫苗供應增加，以及Moderna的COVID-19疫苗。
